# Strait
Strait is an independent publication covering crypto bridges and the infrastructure that moves value across blockchains.
It reports on cross-chain transfers, bridge security, incidents, upgrades, governance, and interoperability.
The site is written for builders, traders, researchers, and readers who want clear context on bridge risk.
Editorial focus: what changed, who bears the risk, and whether systems work as claimed.
